Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct __that differs from the original database constructs__; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein inputting further includes inputting the database constructs as query execution plans for a query __that reflects the characteristics of the database constructs__. 

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 2, wherein inputting further includes identifying at least one database construct as a least cost query execution plan identified from the query execution plans by the database optimizer __and wherein the least cost query execution plan is not the only identified plan__.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics __that are updated based on database operation performance__ associated with the database operation and the database constructs. 

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with __varied__ database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, __or changing resources__ that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time. 

Claim 15 (Cancelled) 

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12, wherein training further includes training the machine-learning algorithm as a linear regression-based machine-learning algorithm __with application to real-time data__.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes selecting a different execution resource for processing of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time __and considering the real-time performance of the execution resource__. 

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs __and at least one associated performance metric__ and the database operation; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predict value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time for a query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system __based on historical performance data__.
